notes: T(n,j) is the Lehmer sequence with (a+b)^2=j, ab=-1, A(n,j) its companion; G_k(n) is a product of distinct homogenised cyclotomic values P_d (d>=3), and G_{k+1}(n)=G_k(p_k n)/G_k(n) keeps the d with v_{p_k}(d)=v_{p_k}(n)+1, so all quotients are integers. Checked numerically j=0..12, primes 2..11. Outside Lean: the whole argument.

sources.cite: D. H. Lehmer, An extended theory of Lucas' functions, Ann. Math. 31 (1930)
